facts: The archived NIOSH table entry for "Potassium hydroxide (solution <70% only)" places the following materials in the 8 hr group: Butyl, Natural, Nitrile, PVC, Viton.
The archived NIOSH table entry for "Potassium hydroxide (solution <70% only)" places the following materials in the 4 hr group: Teflon, PE/EVAL.

The archived NIOSH table defines the time-group designations as: "8 hr = More than 8 hours of resistance to breakthrough >0.1 g/cm2/min. 4 hr = At least 4 but less than 8 hours of resistance to breakthrough >0.1 g/cm2/min."
payload.query: For potassium hydroxide solution below 70 percent, which barriers does the archived NIOSH table place in its 8-hour group and which in its 4-hour group?

- The archived NIOSH table defines the time-group designations as: "8 hr = More than 8 hours of resistance to breakthrough >0.1 g/cm2/min. 4 hr = At least 4 but less than 8 hours of resistance to breakthrough >0.1 g/cm2/min."
